chapter.verse: Note kiangah kiniamsak a, note tawh a kikhen ciangin a hang keimah Paul in Khazih’ lungnemna leh hehpihna tawh note kong thuum hi.

Kote in ci-le-sa ngeina bangin a gamta mi ka hi uh ci-in hong ngaihsun mi kimkhatte kiangah lau lo-a ka hanciam bangin, note kiangah ka hong tun’ ciangin tua zah lau lohnate om loh nadingin kong thuum hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, kote in ci-le-sa ngeina bangin ka gamtat uh hangin ci-le-sa ngeina bangin gal ka do kei uh hi.
Kote’ galdona-a ka zat uh hiamte in ci-le-sa tawh kipawl ahi kei hi: khuapi kulhte a cim gawpsak thei, Pasian mai-ah vangliatna tawh a dim hiam ahi uh hi.
Tua hiamte tawh mi hanciamna ahi zongin, Pasian theihna pilna lang khatah a kiphasak ngaihsutnate ahi zongin khuplet gawpin, lungsim khempeuh manin khumcipin Khazih’ thu ka ngaisak uh hi.
Note thungaihna in a kicin’ khit ciangin thungai lo khempeuh daan pia dingin a baihsa-in ka om uh hi.

Note in na maitang uh a, omte bek en na hi uh hi. Mi khat in, “Kei Khazih’ mi ka hi,” ci-in amahmah a ki-up leh, tuapa in Khazih’ mi a hih bangin kote zong Khazih’ mi ka hih thu uh, khat vei amahmah in ngaihsun ta hen.
Note sukgawp nading hi lo, hong kipsak nadingin Topa in kote a hong piak thuneihna-ah a tampi ka kisaktheih hangin zumna ka thuak kei ding hi.
Ka hong piak lai tawh note hong tawng bangin ka hi nuam kei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, “Ama lai in a gik a vanglian tawh kidim lai a hih hangin ama pumpi ahih leh, hatna nei lo, thu-a kimang lo kam a pau thei mi hi,” a ci mi a om thei hi.
Kote in ka pumpi uh a om loh ciangin lai sungah ka gelh uh kammal bangin ka hih uh bangin, komau pumpi uh a om ciangin zong a hihte ka hi uh hi, ci-in tua mite in ciamteh ta uh hen.
Amau mah a kiphatte tawh kisimkhopna ahi zongin, kidemna ahi zongin ka hih ngam kei uh hi. Tuate in khat leh khat kitehin kidem uh a, pilna nei lo uh hi.

Kote ka hih uh leh, ka sep ding uh kheng a, ka bawlna uhah ka kisathei kei ding uh hi. Pasian in hong hawmsak ka nasep ding uh kitehna sungah ka hihna uh bekah ka kisathei ding uh hi. Tua kitehna in note dongin ka hong ban uh hi.
Note dong hong ban lo bangin kote in khengin sem ka hi kei uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Khazih’ Lungdamna Thu hilh dingin note omna dongin kong tung zo uh hi.
Kote in ka nasep nading uh khenin mi dangte’ nasepna sungah ka tum uh ahih maninah kisathei ka hi kei uh hi.

Tua bang amau sepna sungah a kibawlsa nate-ah kisathei loin, note gam lang khatah galkah-in Pasian’ Lungdamna Thu hilh theihna om nadingin note thu-upna a khan’ lai takin kote nasepna in a tanzau mahmah ding hi ci-in ka lawp uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a kisathei mi in Topa sung bekah kisathei ta hen.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amahmah a kiphat mi in san’ huai lo hi; Topa’ phatna a ngah mi in san’ ding a kilawm hi.
